before.detail: paths and body lines truncated by cells; max 400 body lines; no full view or directory copy text
before.runtime: entire skill readFile + unbounded Map keyed by id; no refresh invalidation or late-request guard

files.internalReplacement: unbounded full-content cache replaced by bounded preview and disk pager

implementation.indexLookup: binary search by wrapped row then decode nearest byte checkpoint
implementation.decoding: strict UTF-8 full reader; supports CRLF/CR, split multibyte sequences, CJK/emoji through shared cell-width helper; strips C0/C1 controls and expands tab to space
implementation.fullText: original file including frontmatter; no 400-line cap
implementation.paths: scan path, real path, containing directory and root as scrollable text; terminal copy instructions
implementation.refresh: scan object change invalidates preview; late preview/full/page generations ignored
implementation.identity: dev/ino/size/mtimeMs/ctimeMs for opened ordinary file and path; verify after index and around page reads
implementation.lifecycle: abort controller and close on cancel, width change, replacement and runtime disposal; progress throttled to 150ms
implementation.mouse: footer buttons, pager and wheel, actual SGR press/release verified

coverage: UTF-8 disk chunk and checkpoint boundaries

verificationCorrections.finding: test matched plain i 全文 preview hint instead of [i 全文] button
verificationCorrections.resolution: use bracketed footer target; speculative layout/hit-area changes reverted; actual pointer path passed

verificationCorrections.finding: test assumed one PageDown and unbroken SKILL.md substring
verificationCorrections.resolution: read successive pages and normalize visible wraps/borders; both sizes independently rechecked before full rerun

realTui.externalChangeByTestOnly: append REAL-EXTERNAL-END; then restore exact original

finalReleaseCheck.scope: Final source, tests and packed README; subsequent updates only non-packed docs/evidence

limits: First full open/width change performs a cancelable O(file bytes) index scan; resizing restarts at first page
Existing skill discovery still reads/parses files; this is not proof of end-to-end huge-file/1000-skill performance
UTF-8 ordinary files only; no content editing, file-manager invocation or automatic clipboard write
Long copy text wraps visually and needs manual joining of continuation lines
File identity checks are not an atomic snapshot or a guarantee against arbitrary metadata-preserving concurrent writes
